name: 日常英语
description: 日常口语主题分类词汇，按主题分关卡（称呼/数字/颜色/食物…）（来源：FunctionFun/English-Words 日常分类高频词）

words.example: [as form of address] Aw, Mom, why can't I go?  哦，妈妈，为甚么我不能去？

words.meaning: n. 爸爸；爹爹；n. (Dad)人名；(孟、巴基、阿富)达德；(泰)达
words.example:
It was lovely to see your mum and dad at the school concert last night.  很高兴昨天晚上在学校音乐会上见到你爸妈。
[as form of address] Can you give me a lift back from the cinema tonight, Dad?  爸，今天晚上能不能顺便开车把我从戏院送回家？
Grandma tells us stories every night.  奶奶每晚给我们讲故事。
My grandpa takes a walk after dinner.  爷爷晚饭后去散步。

I've got several uncles and aunts.  我有几个叔叔和姑姑。
We invited my Uncle Steve round.  我们邀请了我的叔叔史蒂夫过来。
[as form of address] Did you bring me a present, Uncle Jack?  你给我带礼物了吗，杰克叔叔？
Auntie Camille  卡米尔姑妈

Do you have any brothers and sisters?  你有兄弟姐妹吗？
Johnny is my younger/older/big/baby/little brother.  强尼是我的弟弟／哥哥／大哥／小弟弟。
My brother lives in Washington.  我哥哥住在华盛顿。

Sophie and Emily are sisters.  苏菲和艾蜜莉是姐妹。
Emily is Sophie's younger/little/older/big sister.  艾蜜莉是苏菲的妹妹／姐姐。
Lynn's such a good friend - she's like a sister to me.  琳恩真是一个好朋友——她就像我的姐妹一样。

My brother's wife and I both had babies around the same time, so the cousins are very close in age.  我嫂子和我差不多同时生了孩子，因此这对表兄妹年纪相若。
Many of our distant cousins, whom we hadn't seen for years, came to my sister's wedding.  我们家许多多年未见的远房亲戚赶来参加姐姐的婚礼。
We Americans owe a great deal to our European cousins.  我们美国人得到欧洲兄弟的许多帮助。

She's my best/oldest/closest friend - we've known each other since we were five.  她是我最要好／交情最久／最亲密的朋友——我们五岁的时候就认识了。
He's a family friend/friend of the family.  他是全家人的朋友。
This restaurant was recommended to me by a friend of mine.  这间餐厅是我的一个朋友给我推荐的。
Our teacher is very patient with us.  我们的老师对我们很有耐心。

The doctor prescribed some pills.  医生开了一些药。
You should see a doctor about that cough.  你咳嗽应该找医生看看。
[as form of address] Good morning, Doctor Smith/Doctor.  早上好，史密斯医生／医生。

He worked as a nurse in a psychiatric hospital.  他在精神病院当护士。
Nurse Millard will be with you shortly.  米勒德护士很快会来照顾你。
[as form of address] Thank you, Nurse.  谢谢你，护士。

She was the boss of a large international company.  她是一家大型跨国公司的老板。
informal Who's the boss (= the person who makes all the important decisions) in your house?  你们家谁做主？UK noun countable
It was a boss party.  那个派对棒极了。
We're entertaining some colleagues of Ben's tonight.  今晚我们要招待本的几位同事。UK noun countable
My neighbor waters my plants when I travel.  我旅行时邻居帮我浇花。

My mother always warned me not to talk to strangers.  我母亲总是告诫我不要和陌生人讲话。
I'd never met anyone at the party before - they were complete strangers.  我以前从未见过聚会上的人——他们全是陌生人。
Do you know the way to St Peter's church or are you a stranger here too?  你知道怎么去圣彼得教堂吗？你也是外地人吗？UK noun countable

Would you like to see the menu, sir?  您要看看菜单吗，先生?
I'm not going to ride the subway, no sir!  我不会去乘地铁，绝对不会！

[as form of address] May I carry your cases for you, Madam?  需要帮您提箱子吗，夫人？
She's turning into a proper little madam.  她正在变成一个十足的小妇人。noun

You've got three bags and I've only got one.  你有3个袋子，我只有1个。
She'll be one year old tomorrow.  明天她就一岁了。
Americans drive one third of the 400 million cars on the planet.  这个星球上4亿辆汽车中有1/3是美国人驾驶的。

They've got two houses.  他们有两幢房子。
It's two o'clock.  两点了。
He'll be two (years old) in February.  二月他就两岁了。number

I've got three sisters.  我有三个姐妹。
School finishes at three o'clock.  学校在三点钟放学。number

Most animals have four legs.  大多数动物都有四条腿。
We need four people to make up a team.  我们组队需要四个人。UK noun countable [+ sing/pl verb]
You'll have to get down on all fours to clean behind the toilet.  你要趴到地上才能擦洗到马桶后面的区域。
Five, four, three, two, one, blast-off!  五，四，三，二，一，点火！

Look for a bus with a number six on the front of it.  找一辆前面有数字六的公车。
We've been at sixes and sevens in the office this week.  我们办公室这一周忙得不可开交。number
There's no point worrying about it - we'll both be six feet under by then.  不用为此担心——到时候我们俩都已经入土了。number

The restaurant opens for dinner at seven o'clock.  餐厅在七点钟开门供应晚餐。
We're open seven days a week (= every day).  我们一周七天都开放。

She was eight years old when her family moved here.  八岁那年，她家搬到了这里。
We've got eight people coming to dinner.  有八位客人要到我们家来吃晚餐。

The birthday girl was wearing a badge with a nine on it.  过生日的女孩戴着一个上面有9字的徽章。
She's tired of working nine to five.  她厌倦了朝九晚五的工作。number
The doorbell rang and there was Chris, all dressed up to the nines.  门铃一响，衣着华丽的克里丝来了。number

We have hired a minibus to take ten people to the party on Friday.  我们租了一辆小巴士在星期五带十个人去参加聚会。
Her father died ten years ago.  她的父亲在十年前去世了。number
Ten to one he won't be there tonight.  他今晚十之八九不会去那里。
There are eleven girls in my class and fifteen boys.  我班上有11个女生和15个男生。noun countable [+ sing/pl verb]
a twelve-seater minibus  12座的小巴
Some people think that thirteen is an unlucky number.  一些人认为十三是个不吉利的数字。
Her baby is fourteen months old.  她的孩子14个月大了。
"How many books were returned?" "Fifteen (books)."  “还回了多少本书？”“15本。”
We've got sixteen (people) coming for lunch.  我们有16个人来吃午饭。
Is that a seventeen on the front of that bus?  那辆公车的前面是不是写着17？
an eighteen-storey building  一座十八层建筑物
Simson, aged nineteen, was convicted on two charges of burglary.  19岁的西姆森被判两项盗窃罪罪成。
space for twenty people  可容纳20个人的空间
She got married when she was thirty (years old).  她三十岁时结婚的。
He looks about forty.  他看上去40岁上下。
"How fast were they driving?" "They were doing fifty (miles an hour)."  “他们当时的车速有多快？”“他们的时速达到了50英里。”

There are sixty (people) coming to the wedding.  有60人来参加婚礼。noun
Many people retire in their sixties.  许多人60多岁退休。
The temperature is usually in/around the sixties at this time of year.  每年这个时候的气温通常都是华氏60多度。

This house was built seventy years ago.  这栋房子建于70年前。
She's getting on for seventy.  她将近七十岁了。UK noun
He's very active considering he's in his seventies.  鉴于他都70多岁了，他已经算是非常有活力的了。
They've invited eighty (guests) to the wedding.  他们邀请了80个（客）人参加他们的婚礼。

Ninety percent of the people surveyed were in favour.  90%的被访者表示赞成。UK number
Ninety-nine times out of a hundred everything's fine, but now and then there's a problem.  大多数时候一切顺利，但偶尔也会出现问题。

We've driven a/one hundred miles in the last two hours.  这两个小时我们已经开了100英哩了。
That dress costs hundreds of pounds.  那条裙子价值数百英镑。
There were hundreds of people at the pool today.  今天游泳池里人很多。

I've got a thousand things to do before we go on holiday.  我们去渡假前，我还有很多事情要做。
His latest work is expected to sell in the thousands.  他的最新作品预计可卖出上千上万册。 (plural thousand or thousands)

She got eight million dollars for appearing in that film.  她出演那部电影拿到了800万美元的片酬。
In wealthy parts of the country, homes cost from £ 750 000 into the millions.  在这个国家的富裕地区，房屋的价钱从75万到数百万英镑不等。number (plural million or millions)
Thanks again - you're one in a million!  再次感谢——你真是个难得的好人！number (plural million or millions)

This is my first visit to New York.  这是我第一次到纽约。
I'm always nervous for the first few minutes of an exam.  考试开始的头几分钟我总是很紧张。
The trousers shrank when I washed them, but they weren't really big enough in the first place.  这条长裤洗过后缩水了，但是它原本就不够大。

Is Brian her first or second child?  布莱恩是她的第一个还是第二个孩子？
This is the second time I've had flu this winter.  这是今年冬天以来我的第二场感冒。
First prize is a fortnight in Barbados and second prize is a weekend in Rome.  头奖是巴巴多斯双环游，二奖是罗马周末游。

She came third in the exam.  她在考试中得了第三名。UK ordinal number
He cut the cake into thirds (= three equal parts).  他把蛋糕切成三份。UK noun countable

My birthday is on the fourth of December.  我的生日是12月4日。
Daniel was/finished fourth in the race.  丹尼尔在比赛中获得了第四名。

Tomorrow is the fifth (of September).  明天是（9月）5号。ordinal number
One fifth is the same as 20 percent.  五分之一也就是20%。

The dress was bright red.  这件连衣裙是鲜红色的。
Look, you've embarrassed him - he's gone bright red!  瞧，你让他很尴尬——他的脸都红了！
Don't tell him you're a vegetarian - it's like a red rag to a bull.  不要告诉他你是个素食主义者——这会让他极为不快。adjective (redder, reddest)

Her hands were blue with cold (= slightly blue because of the cold).  她的手冻得发青。adjective
His humour is a bit too blue for my tastes.  他的幽默对我来说有点儿太下流了。adjective
He's been a bit blue since he failed his exams.  自从考试不及格后，他就一直有些闷闷不乐。

He used to be a Liberal, but now he's a Green.  他以前是自由党成员，但是现在加入绿党了。
The Chancellor proposed a crackdown on car and plane emissions, and the introduction of tax incentives to go green.  总理提议打击汽车及飞机的废气排放，并为保护环境设立激励性税收。adjective
Ben's heading off to Spain for the week and I'm green with envy.  本要到西班牙逗留一星期，真令我眼红。adjective

It was early autumn and the leaves were turning yellow.  正值初秋时节，树叶开始转黄。
You should wear more yellow - it suits you.  你应该多穿些黄色的衣服——那适合你。UK adjective

The future looked black.  未来希望渺茫。
She often dresses in black (= in black clothes).  她经常穿黑色衣服。
The old newsreels were filmed in black and white.  以前的新闻短片是用黑白底片拍制的。

He's white-haired now.  他现在头发都已经白了。
He had a black mother and a white father.  他的母亲是黑人，父亲是白人。
In some countries it is traditional for a bride to wear white.  在某些国家的传统中，新娘要穿白色礼服。
The sky turned gray before the storm.  暴风雨来临前天空变成了灰色。

Both my parents have curly brown hair.  我的父母都有一头棕色的鬈发。verb intransitive or transitive
Lightly brown the onion before adding the tomatoes.  加番茄之前先把洋葱炒至略呈褐色。
Allow the meat to brown before adding the vegetables.  把肉炒成褐色再加蔬菜。

Have you been in the sun? Your nose is a bit pink.  你晒太阳了吗？你的鼻子有点发红。adjective
She's very fond of pink.  她很喜欢粉红色。noun

Despite occasional patches of purple prose , the book is mostly clear and incisive.  这本书尽管偶尔有几段词藻华丽的文句，但总体来讲文风简洁明了。UK noun countable or uncountable
Purple is my favourite colour.  我喜欢的颜色是紫色。
The evening sky was full of purples and reds.  傍晚的天空布满紫色和红色的云彩。
The setting sun filled the sky with a deep orange glow.  落日的余晖将天空染成了橙红色。UK noun countable or uncountable
He's running so well, surely he'll take the gold.  他跑得很出色，肯定能拿金牌UK adjective

We gave Alison and Tom a dish made of solid silver as a wedding present.  我们送给爱丽森和汤姆一个纯银盘子作为结婚礼物。
Cleaning the silver (= silver objects) is a dirty job.  擦洗银器是一件很讨厌的事。
Shall we use the silver (= utensils made of silver) for dinner tonight?  今天晚餐要用银餐具吗?

words.meaning: n. 米黄色；adj. 浅褐色的；米黄色的；枯燥乏味的；n. (Beige)人名；(法)贝热
words.example: She painted the walls beige.  她把墙刷成了米色。

My brother is an officer in the Navy.  我兄弟是海军军官。
Gabriel joined the navy in 1997.  加伯利于1997年加入海军。
He was wearing a navy sweater.  他穿着一件深蓝色的毛线衣。
He held out an olive branch to the opposition by releasing 42 political prisoners.  他释放了42名政治犯，以此向反对派表达了和解的愿望。
The logo uses cyan and white.  这个标志用了青色和白色。

words.meaning: n./a.紫红色(的)；n.紫红色的染料
words.example: The printer needs magenta ink.  打印机需要品红色墨水。
Do you prefer brown rice or white rice?  你喜欢吃糙米还是精米？
egg/rice noodles  鸡蛋面／米粉

This bread is fresh/stale.  这面包是新鲜的／变味了。
Do you bake your own bread?  你自己烤面包吗？noun uncountable
He earns his daily bread as a tourist guide.  他靠做导游谋生。noun uncountable

How do you like your eggs - fried or boiled?  鸡蛋你想怎样吃？是吃煎的还是煮的？
The cuckoo lays her egg in another bird's nest.  杜鹃将卵产在其他鸟的巢里。
After fourteen days the eggs hatch.  14天后，卵孵化了。

Breast/Mother's milk is the best nourishment for a baby.  母乳是婴儿最好的营养品。
She's full of the milk of human kindness.  她本性仁慈善良。verb
Milking a cow by hand is a skilled process.  挤牛奶是一项需要专门技术的工作。
It was a nicely written article and quite amusing but there wasn't much meat to it.  这是篇文笔优美又饶有趣味的文章，但没甚么实质内容。noun

We're having roast/fried chicken for dinner.  晚饭我们吃烤鸡／炸鸡。noun
Jump, you chicken!  跳呀，你这胆小鬼！noun
Why won't you jump? Are you chicken?  你干吗不跳？害怕了？verb

Several large fish live in the pond.  池塘里有几条大鱼。
Sanjay caught the biggest fish I've ever seen.  桑杰伊捉到的鱼是我见过最大的。
Don't cry over Pierre - there are plenty more fish in the sea!  别为皮埃尔哭了，天下的好男人多的是！verb

The spaghetti sauce is made with UK minced / US ground beef.  这种意粉的调味汁是用牛肉碎做成的。
People in England often have roast beef and Yorkshire pudding for lunch on Sundays.  英国人在星期天的午餐，通常是吃烤牛肉和约克郡布丁。
He is a beef cattle farmer.  他专门饲养菜牛。noun
a pork chop  猪排

The potato is the most popular vegetable in Britain.  在英国，马铃薯是最受欢迎的蔬菜。
In the winter we tend to eat more root vegetables, such as carrots and parsnips.  冬天我们往往会吃更多根茎蔬菜，比如胡萝卜和欧洲萝卜。
Raw vegetables contain more potassium than cooked ones.  生的蔬菜中所含的钾元素比煮熟后的要多。

Apricots are the one fruit I don't like.  水果中只有杏子是我不爱吃的。
Oranges, apples, pears and bananas are all types of fruit.  柳橙、苹果、梨和香蕉都是水果。
Would you like some fruit for dessert?  餐后甜点你想要些水果吗？

His youngest daughter was the apple of his eye.  他的小女儿是他的心肝宝贝。noun countable or uncountable
Their house is always in apple-pie order.  他们家总是收拾得井井有条。
a bunch of bananas  一串香蕉
black/white/red/green grapes  紫／白／红／绿葡萄
We shared a watermelon in summer.  夏天我们一起吃西瓜。
boiled/roasted/fried potatoes  煮／烤／炸马铃薯
Tomato soup is my favorite.  番茄汤是我的最爱。
Sometimes I just have to resort to the carrot and stick approach with my children.  有时候我只能对我的孩子采取软硬兼施的办法。

Toss (= Mix) the salad with a vinaigrette dressing.  用油醋酱调味料拌沙拉。
Serve the risotto with a mixed salad.  用什锦沙拉配义大利炖饭。

Would you like a bowl of soup?  你要不要来碗汤？noun countable or uncountable
New circuit boards can be used to soup up existing machines.  新电路板可用来提高现有机器的性能。    souped-up    /ˌsuːptˈʌp]

Would you get some coffee when you go shopping?  你去买东西时买点咖啡好吗？
If I drink too much coffee, I can't sleep.  要是咖啡喝得太多，我会睡不着觉。
Can I get you a coffee (= cup of coffee) ?  我给你来杯咖啡吧？

I'd love a cup of tea, please.  请给我来一杯茶。
Tea and biscuits will be provided at 11 o'clock.  11点会提供茶点。
How do you like your tea - strong or weak ?  你喜欢喝甚么样的茶——浓的还是淡的？

Fry the meat first to seal in the juices.  先把肉煎一煎锁住肉汁。noun
My cousin Gianni's got all the juice in this neighborhood.  我的堂哥吉安尼在这一带很有影响力。noun
This early in the morning it's hard to get the creative juices flowing (= to start thinking of good ideas).  这么一大早很难想出甚么好点子。
I'd like a Coke with ice, please.  请给我一杯加冰可乐。

words.meaning: n. 比萨饼（一种涂有乳酪和番茄酱的意大利式有馅烘饼）；n. (Pizza)人名；(意)皮扎
words.example: a slice of pizza  一块比萨
He ate a hamburger for lunch.  他午餐吃了一个汉堡包。
On the train I was sandwiched between two very large men.  在火车上，我被两个壮汉夹在中间。verb

Don't write in (= using a) pen, or you won't be able to rub out any mistakes you make.  不要用钢笔写，否则写错就擦不掉了。noun countable
He served nine years in the state pen.  他在州立监狱服刑九年。noun countable
It's time you put pen to paper and replied to that letter from your mother.  该动笔给你妈妈回信了。verb transitive (-nn-)    formal

He sat with his pencil poised , ready to take notes.  他坐着，手里拿着铅笔准备写笔记。
The pencil's blunt - you'd better sharpen it (= make its point sharp).  铅笔钝了——你最好削一下。
Write your comments in the margin of the report in (= using) pencil.  把你的意见用铅笔写在报告的页边上。

She wrote a book on car maintenance.  她写了一本关于汽车保养的书。
At the end of the year, the accountant goes over (= checks) the books.  年终时会计要覆核公司的帐册。
Running a school is much more of a business than it used to be, - by law we have to balance our books.  与以前相比现在管理一所学校更像是在经营一家企业——从法律上讲我们必须保证收支平衡。
She was jotting things down in a little notebook.  她在一个小笔记本上匆匆记了些东西。UK noun countable

Just then, his mobile phone rang.  就在那时，他的手机响了。
Could you answer the phone?  你能接电话吗？
We speak on the/by phone about twice a week.  我们一周大约通两次电话。

All our customer orders are handled by computer.  我们所有顾客的订单都是用电脑来处理的。
We've put all our records on computer.  我们把自己所有的纪录都输入了电脑。
I take my laptop to the cafe.  我带着笔记本电脑去咖啡馆。

He spent the entire afternoon watching a cricket match.  他整个下午都在看一场板球比赛。
Bonner watched helplessly as the ball sneaked in at the near post.  邦纳无助地看着球从近端的球门柱旁滚进球门。
She'll pretend that she hasn't seen us - you watch.  她会假装没看见我们的——你看着吧。
I can't read without my glasses.  不戴眼镜我看不清。

Don't eat that whole bag of (= the amount the bag contains) sweets at once.  不要一次就把整袋糖吃完。
Silly old bag!  又蠢又丑 的老太婆！noun countable
Come and stay with us - we've got bags of room.  来跟我们一起住吧——我们那边地方很大。

Would you mind speaking more slowly, please?  请你再说慢点，好吗？
If he tells Julie what I said, I'll never speak to him again.  如果他把我说的话告诉茱莉，我就再也不和他说话。
formal She spoke of her sadness over her father's death.  她谈起了父亲过世带给她的悲伤。

We were just talking about Simon's new girlfriend.  我们刚才在谈论赛门的新女友。
My little girl has just started to talk.  我的小女儿刚开始说话。
She talks to her mother on the phone every week.  她每周都跟母亲通电话。

Turn the light on so I can see.  打开灯，这样我才看得到。
See (= Look at) p. 23 for prices and flight details.  票价与航班的具体详情请见第23页。
See over (= Look at the next page) for further information.  更多资讯见下一页。

Look! There's grandma.  看！祖母在那里。
They looked at the picture and laughed.  他们看了看那幅画，笑了起来
Look at all this rubbish on the floor.  瞧瞧地上这些垃圾。

Eventually she had saved enough money to buy a small car.  她最终存够了买一辆小汽车的钱。
There are more people buying at this time of the year so prices are high.  这个季节购物的人比较多，所以价格高昂。
The company was set up to buy and sell shares on behalf of investors.  成立该公司为的是代表投资者买卖股票。

We'll be selling the tickets at/for £50 each.  我们每张票将卖50英镑。
The stall sells drinks and snacks.  这个摊位卖饮料和小吃。
These baskets sell well (= a lot of them are bought).  这些篮子卖得很好。 (sold, sold)

Has anything been taken (= stolen) ?  丢了甚么东西吗？
Here's your pen, I took it by mistake.  你的笔在这里，我拿错了。
All possessions had been taken from her.  她所有财产都被剥夺了。

Can you help me bring in (= take into the house) the shopping?  你能帮我把买的东西拿进屋里吗？
The police brought several men in for questioning (= took them to the police station because they might have been involved in a crime).  警方带了几个人回警局问话。
When they visit us they always bring their dog with them.  他们来看我们时总是把狗带来。 (brought, brought)

Shall I make some coffee?  我煮些咖啡好吗？
He'd made a chocolate cake.  他做了一个巧克力蛋糕。
She makes all her own clothes.  她所有的衣服都是自己做的。

That was a really stupid thing to do.  那么做真是太愚蠢了。
Why were you sent home from school early? What have you done now?  你为甚么放学这么早？你又干了甚么事？
What are you doing over the weekend?  这周末你准备干甚么？

Make sure your hands are clean before you have your dinner.  饭前一定要把手洗干净。
Hospitals need to be kept spotlessly (= extremely) clean.  医院必须保持一尘不染，干干净净。adjective
The judge took the defendant's clean record (= the absence of previous involvement in crime) into account when passing sentence.  法官在宣判时考虑到被告没有前科。

These sheets need washing.  这些床单需要洗洗。
I'll wash the bottle out (= clean its inside) and use it again.  我要把瓶子洗干净再用。
I'd like to wash before dinner.  吃饭前我要洗洗手。

Let the fish cook for half an hour before you add the wine.  先把鱼煮半个小时再加入酒。verb
Jean's new band was really cooking at the party last night.  琼的新乐队在昨晚聚会上的演出确实很棒。verb
Just tell her we can't - that'll cook her goose.  只要告诉她我们不能——那她就没戏了。verb

The children spent the afternoon playing in the garden.  孩子们下午在花园里玩耍。
My daughter used to play with the kids next door.  我女儿以前常跟隔壁的孩子们玩。verb
Do you want to play cards/football (with us)?  你想（和我们）打牌／踢球吗？

The children sang two songs by Schubert at the school concert.  在学校音乐会上，孩子们演唱了舒伯特的两首歌曲。
We were woken early by the sound of the birds singing.  我们很早就被鸟儿的鸣唱声吵醒。
Your grandmother would like you to sing for/to her.  你祖母想叫你唱首歌给她听。

We danced all night.  我们跳了一夜的舞。
We went dancing at a nightclub.  我们去夜总会跳舞。
What sort of music do you like dancing to ?  你喜欢伴着哪种歌曲跳舞？

They laughed at her jokes.  听了她讲的笑话他们都笑了。
She's so funny - she really makes me laugh.  她太有意思了——真让我笑死了。
It's very rare that a book is so good you actually laugh out loud.  一本能让你笑出声来的好书真是不多见。

"There, there, don't cry," she said.  “好啦，好啦，别哭了，”她说道。
We all laughed until we cried.  我们都大笑起来，直到笑出了眼泪。
She cried bitter tears when she got the letter.  收到来信，她流下了痛苦的泪水。

We're having the party in the garden, so I'm praying it'll be sunny.  我们要在花园里举行聚会，所以我正祈祷那天会阳光明媚。adjective
She has a very sunny disposition.  她性情非常开朗。

We had three rainy days on holiday, but otherwise it was sunny.  我们渡假时遇到三个雨天，不过其他的日子都是阳光明媚。adjective
Luckily she had saved some money for a rainy day.  幸好她未雨绸缪早有准备。

Scotland will be cloudy with wintry showers.  苏格兰将会转阴，且有寒冷的阵雨。
The beer was cloudy and dark.  啤酒混浊发黑。

words.meaning: adj. 多风的，有风的；腹胀的；吹牛的
words.example:
It was a windy night.  那是个多风的夜晚。
It was wet and windy for most of the week.  本周的大部分时间都在刮风下雨。
We've had a very snowy winter this year.  今年我们过了一个多雪的冬天。

words.meaning: adj. 有雾的；模糊的，朦胧的
words.example: a cold, foggy day  寒冷多雾的一天UK adjective

It's too hot in here, can we turn down the heating?  这里面太热了，我们能把暖气关小点吗？
Bake the cake in a hot oven, about 220°C, for 30 minutes.  把蛋糕放进烤炉里，用大约摄氏220度的温度烤30分钟。
The food was piping hot (= very hot).  食物是滚烫的。UK adjective (hotter, hottest)

My feet are so cold.  我的双脚冰冷。
It's freezing cold today.  今天冷极了。
You'll feel cold if you don't wear a coat.  如果不穿外套你会觉得冷的。UK adjective

Are you warm enough or do you want the fire on?  你暖不暖和，要不要生火？
I've got my hands in my pockets to keep them warm.  我把手放在口袋里保暖。
Those gloves look nice and warm.  那些手套看起来又漂亮又暖和。

It was a lovely cool evening.  那是个凉爽的夜晚。
How do you manage to look so cool in this hot weather?  这么热的天你怎么看上去会这么凉快？
It 's a bit cool in here, isn't it? I think I'll close the window.  这里有点凉，是不是？我想关上窗户。adjective

These plants grow well in dry soil/a dry climate.  这些植物适宜在干旱的土壤里／气候条件下生长。
This cake's a bit dry - I think I overcooked it.  这个蛋糕有点干——估计是给我烤过头了。
By this time all the wells had run dry.  到这个时候所有的井都已经干枯了。

My bike got wet in the rain.  我的脚踏车在雨中淋湿了。
informal You poor thing - you're all (= very) wet.  你这个可怜的家伙——全身都淋湿了。
The paint's still wet.  油漆还未亁。

They're still clearing up the storm damage.  他们还在清理风暴留下的残局。UK noun
There was a storm of protest when the new tax was announced.  宣布新税目后，引发了抗议风潮。UK noun
Her performance has taken the London critics by storm.  她的表演完全征服了伦敦评论界。UK noun
The tropical butterfly's wings were shimmering with all the colours of the rainbow.  热带蝴蝶的翅膀像彩虹一样闪烁着五彩缤纷的色彩。

The sky grew dark and it started to thunder.  天色变暗，开始打雷了。
The train thundered past, shaking the whole house.  火车轰隆隆驶过，整座房子都晃动起来。

That tree was struck by lightning.  那棵树被闪电击中了。
She changed her clothes with lightning speed (= extremely quickly).  她飞快地换了衣服。noun uncountable

She looks so happy.  她看起来非常快乐。
School days are said to be the happiest days of your life.  学生时代据说是一生中最快乐的时光。
Nicky seems a lot happier since she met Steve.  尼基自从认识史蒂夫之后似乎快乐多了。

I've just received some very sad news.  我刚刚得到一些令人伤心的消息。
She gave a rather sad smile.  她露出一丝苦笑。
I'm so sad (that) you can't come.  你不能来，我很遗憾。

He's really angry at/with me for upsetting Sophie.  因为我惹了索菲，他很生我的气。
It made me really angry.  这让我很恼火。adjective
On her leg was an angry sore.  她腿上长了一个疮，又红又肿。

words.meaning: adj. 兴奋的；激动的；活跃的；v. 激动；唤起（excite的过去分词）
words.example:
Are you getting excited about your holiday?  要去渡假了，你是不是很兴奋啊？
An excited crowd waited for the singer to arrive.  一群人怀着激动的心情等待歌星来临。UK adjective
It's a competent enough first novel but nothing to get excited about.  作为第一部小说，写得算不错，但却没有特别出众的地方。

My legs are tired.  我的腿酸了。
She spoke in a tired voice.  她说话有气无力的。UK adjective
It's always the same tired old faces at these meetings.  在这些会上总是些不变的令人生厌的老面孔。

words.meaning: adj. 害怕的；v. 使害怕（scare的过去分词）
words.example:
He's scared of spiders.  他害怕蜘蛛。
I'm scared of telling her what really happened.  我害怕告诉她事情的真相。
He's scared to tell her what really happened.  他不敢告诉她事情的真相。

words.meaning: adj. 感到惊讶的，出人意料的；v. 使惊奇（surprise的过去分词形式）
words.example:
We were very surprised at the result.  这个结果让我们觉得很意外。
It's not like you to behave like this, Alice - I'm surprised at you (= I feel disappointed with you) !  爱丽斯，这太不像你的所作所为了——你真让我感到意外！
I'm not surprised (that) he didn't keep his promise.  果然不出我所料，他没有遵守他的诺言。

words.meaning: adj. 无聊的；无趣的；烦人的；v. 使厌烦（bore的过去式）；烦扰
words.example:
It was a cold, wet day and the children were bored.  那是一个阴冷而潮湿的日子，孩子们都很无聊。
He was getting bored with/of doing the same thing every day.  每天都做同样的事他感到很无聊。UK adjective

He was too shy to ask her to dance with him.  他太害羞了，不敢邀请她跳舞。
She gave a shy smile.  她害羞地笑了一下。
Children are often shy of/with people they don't know.  孩子们和不认识的人在一起时常常会害羞。

You must be very proud of your son.  你一定为你的儿子感到非常自豪。
We're particularly proud of our company's environmental record.  我们为我们公司在环保方面的良好记录感到特别自豪。
When she received her prize I think I was the proudest parent on the face of the Earth.  她领奖时，我感到我是世界上最自豪的父母。
Christmas is such a joyful time of year.  圣诞节是一年中令人快乐的时节。

words.meaning: adj. 高兴的；欣喜的；v. 使…兴高采烈；感到快乐（delight的过去分词）
words.example: We're delighted with our new house.  我们对新房子非常满意。

He's usually fairly cheerful.  他总是乐呵呵的。
You're in a cheerful mood this morning.  今天早上你心情不错嘛。
She manages to stay cheerful (= happy and positive) despite everything.  尽管事事不顺心，她仍然努力保持愉快的心情。
She is optimistic about her chances of winning a gold medal.  她对赢得金牌很乐观。

Be a bit more confident in yourself!  你应该再自信一点！
They don't sound confident about the future of the industry.  他们听起来对该行业的未来信心不足。
I'm confident of his skills as a manager.  作为经理他相当老练，我对此很有信心。

I'm so grateful (to you) for all that you've done.  你为我做了这一切，我（对你）真是感激不尽。
If you could get that report finished by Thursday I'd be very grateful.  如果你能在星期四之前完成那份报告，我将感激不尽。
After the earthquake we felt grateful to be alive.  地震后，我们大难不死，真是应该感谢上苍。

He was hopeful about the outcome of the meeting.  他对会议的结果充满希望。
They were hopeful of a successful agreement.  他们对成功达成协议充满希望。
I'm hopeful (that) we can reach a compromise.  我对我们能达成和解充满希望。
You don't seem very enthusiastic about the party - don't you want to go tonight?  你好像对这个派对不怎么热衷——你今晚不想去了吗？

words.meaning: adj. 亲爱的；钟情的；忠诚的；n. (Loving)人名；(英、瑞典)洛文
words.example:
He's a very loving child.  他是个非常有爱心的孩子。
She's very loving.  她很有爱心。

words.meaning: adj. 感到满意的；v. 使满意（satisfy的过去式）
words.example:
Some people are never satisfied!  有些人永远不会满足！
Are you satisfied with the new arrangement?  你对新的安排满意吗？UK adjective
The judge was satisfied (that) she was telling the truth.  法官相信她在说实话。
That's enough to make anyone unhappy.  所有人都会为此忧伤。

words.meaning: adj. 沮丧的；萧条的；压低的；v. 使沮丧；使萧条（depress的过去式和过去分词形式）；压低
words.example:
He seemed a bit depressed about his work situation.  他似乎对自己的工作状况有些沮丧。
She became deeply depressed when her husband died.  丈夫去世后，她变得十分消沉。adjective
In a depressed market, it's difficult to sell goods unless you lower your prices.  市场不景气只能降价，否则很难把货物卖出去。

words.meaning: adj. 失意的，挫败的；泄气的；v. 挫败；阻挠（frustrate的过去式和过去分词形式）
words.example:
Are you feeling frustrated in your present job?  你做现在这份工作感觉失意吗？
Frustrated writers often end up in publishing.  失意的作家最后往往投身出版业。

My mother always gets a bit anxious if we don't arrive when we say we will.  如果我们说好回家却没有回去，我母亲总会有些担心。
The drought has made farmers anxious about the harvest.  这场旱灾使农民因担心收成而焦虑不安。adjective
Developing countries which are anxious for hard currency can rarely afford to protect the environment.  急于获得强势货币的发展中国家很难顾及环保问题。

She was sitting behind her desk with a worried expression/look on her face.  她坐在桌子后面，神色焦急。
They don't seem particularly worried about the situation.  他们看起来对这种局面并不十分担心。
You had me worried (= You made me feel anxious) for a moment back there - I thought you wouldn't be able to stop in time.  你刚才让我担心了一阵——我以为你不能及时停下来。

Do you feel/get nervous during exams?  考试时，你感到紧张吗？
She's always been nervous around dogs.  她一直很怕狗。
He had/was of a nervous disposition.  他是个神经质的人。

words.meaning: adj. 失望的，沮丧的；受挫折的
words.example:
We were deeply disappointed at/about the result.  我们对这个结果深感失望。
His parents were bitterly disappointed in/with him.  父母对他非常失望。
If you're expecting Dad to let you borrow his car, you're going to be sorely disappointed.  如果你指望爸爸能把汽车借给你，那你会失望透顶的。UK adjective

He was annoyed at the way she tried to take over the whole meeting.  她试图操控整个会议，这使他很恼火。
My parents were rather annoyed (that) I hadn't told them about the accident.  我没有告诉父母这次事故，这让他们很生气。
She was annoyed to discover that her husband had taken her car keys.  她丈夫拿走了她的汽车锁匙，她发现后很生气。

words.meaning: adj. 尴尬的；窘迫的；v. 使...困窘；使...局促不安（embarrass的过去分词形式）
words.example: She felt embarrassed about undressing in front of the doctor.  在医生面前脱衣服让她觉得很尴尬。
She gets lonely now that all the kids have left home.  现在孩子们都离开了家，她感到有些孤独。

Babies are curious about everything around them.  婴儿对周围的一切都很好奇。
There was a curious -looking man standing outside.  外面站着个长相古怪的男人。
It's curious (that) Billy hasn't phoned when he promised he would.  比利说他会打电话来，可是还没打过来，真蹊跷。

words.meaning: adj. 困惑的；混乱的；糊涂的；v. 困惑（confuse的过去式）
words.example:
Grandfather gets quite confused sometimes, and doesn't even know what day it is.  祖父有的时候很糊涂，甚至不知道当天是星期几。
I'm a bit confused. Was that her husband or her son she was with?  我有些糊涂。跟她在一起的是她丈夫还是她儿子？
Your essay gets a bit confused halfway through when you introduce too many ideas at once.  你的文章写到一半时一下子提出了太多观点，显得有些混乱。

She was amazed at how calm she felt after the accident.  事故发生后她是如此镇定，这让她自己都觉得惊奇。
We were amazed to discover that we'd been at school together.  我们惊奇地发现原来我们曾经是同学。

You've got nothing to be ashamed of.  你没有需要对甚么感到内疚的。
She ought to be thoroughly ashamed of herself - talking to her mother like that!  她应该感到无地自容才对——她怎么能那样跟她母亲说话！
I'm ashamed to be seen with you when you behave so badly!  你表现得那么恶劣，让别人看到我跟你在一起我都觉得丢面！

He had always been very jealous of his brother's good looks.  他总是很妒忌他哥哥帅气的长相。
Anna says she feels jealous every time another woman looks at her boyfriend.  安娜说每当别的女人看她的男朋友她都会感到妒忌。    Compare enviousadjective
She is very jealous of her independence, and doesn't want to get married.  她很珍惜自己的自由，不想结婚。

He suffers from back trouble too, so he was very sympathetic about my problem.  他自己也受背痛的困扰，所以对我的烦恼深表同情。
She just needed someone who would lend a sympathetic ear to her (= listen to her in a kind and understanding way) once in a while.  她只是需要一个人能不时以一种理解的态度听她倾诉。    Opposite unsympathetic
She comes across as a more sympathetic character in the film.  她在影片中扮演的角色很能引起观众的共鸣。UK adjective

words.meaning: adj. 决定了的；坚决的；v. 决定；断定（determine的过去分词）
words.example: She's sure to get the job she wants - she's a very determined person.  她肯定会得到她想要的那份工作——她是个意志很坚定的人。
He was relieved to see Jeannie reach the other side of the river safely.  看到珍妮安全到达河对岸，他心头一块石头落了地。

She must have done something wrong, because she's looking so guilty.  她一定是做错甚么事了，因为她一脸愧疚。
You've got a guilty conscience - that's why you can't sleep.  你问心有愧——所以会睡不着觉。UK adjective
The jury has to decide whether a person is guilty or innocent of a crime.  陪审团必须就一个人是否有罪作出裁决。

He's a good teacher, but inclined to be a bit impatient with slow learners.  他是个好老师，但对学得慢的学生却总有些不耐烦。
You'd be hopeless looking after children - you're far too impatient!  照顾孩子你是不行的——你太没有耐心了！
He's got a lot of exciting ideas and he's impatient to get started.  他有许多好主意，迫不及待地想动手做。

Coloured paper was cut into circles, squares and triangles.  彩纸被剪成了圆形、正方形和三角形。
We sat in a circle.  我们围坐成一圈。UK noun
The subject was never discussed outside the family circle.  这个话题只在家庭成员间讨论。
A door is usually a rectangle.  门通常是个长方形。
Which earrings did you buy in the end - the triangles or the circles?  最后你买了甚么样的耳环——三角形的还是圆的？

First draw a square.  首先画一个正方形。
It's a square-shaped room.  这是个正方形的房间。
When cooled, cut the chocolate brownies into squares.  冷却之后，将巧克力蛋糕切成四方块。

words.meaning: a.卵形的,椭圆形的 n.卵形,椭圆形
words.example: an oval mirror  椭圆形镜子
Doctors have replaced the top of his hip bone with a metal sphere.  医生们用一个金属球替换了他的髋骨顶端。UK noun countable
Cut the cheese into small cubes.  将起司切成小方块。noun countable
Deep-sea divers carry cylinders (= containers) of oxygen on their backs.  深海潜水员背上背有氧气筒。UK noun countable

words.meaning: n.  圆锥体,球果vt.  使成锥形
words.example: Part of the road had been coned off for repair work.  部分道路用锥形路标封闭起来以便维修。
